record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> O LORD<WH03068>, thou hast searched<WH02713><WTH8804> me, and known<WH03045><WTH8799> <FI>me<Fi> .
Thou knowest<WH03045><WTH8804> my downsitting<WH03427><WTH8800> and mine uprising<WH06965><WTH8800>, thou understandest<WH0995><WTH8804> my thought<WH07454> afar off<WH07350>.
Thou compassest<WH02219><WTH8765> my path<WH0734> and my lying down<WH07252>, and art acquainted<WH05532><WTH8689> <FI>with<Fi> all my ways<WH01870>. <RF>compassest: or, winnowest<Rf>
For <FI>there is<Fi> not a word<WH04405> in my tongue<WH03956>, <FI>but<Fi> , lo, O LORD<WH03068>, thou knowest<WH03045><WTH8804> it altogether.
Thou hast beset<WH06696><WTH8804> me behind<WH0268> and before<WH06924>, and laid<WH07896><WTH8799> thine hand<WH03709> upon me.
<FI> Such<Fi> knowledge<WH01847> <FI>is<Fi> too wonderful<WH06383><WTH8675><WH06383> for me; it is high<WH07682><WTH8738>, I cannot<WH03201><WTH8799> <FI>attain<Fi> unto it.<CM>
Whither shall I go<WH03212><WTH8799> from thy spirit<WH07307>? or whither shall I flee<WH01272><WTH8799> from thy presence<WH06440>?
If I ascend up<WH05266><WTH8799> into heaven<WH08064>, thou <FI>art<Fi> there: if I make my bed<WH03331><WTH8686> in hell<WH07585>, behold, thou <FI>art there<Fi> .
<FI> If<Fi> I take<WH05375><WTH8799> the wings<WH03671> of the morning<WH07837>, <FI>and<Fi> dwell<WH07931><WTH8799> in the uttermost parts<WH0319> of the sea<WH03220>;
Even there shall thy hand<WH03027> lead<WH05148><WTH8686> me, and thy right hand<WH03225> shall hold<WH0270><WTH8799> me.
If I say<WH0559><WTH8799>, Surely the darkness<WH02822> shall cover<WH07779><WTH8799> me; even the night<WH03915> shall be light<WH0216> about me<WH01157>.

Yea, the darkness<WH02822> hideth<WH02821><WTH8686> not from thee; but the night<WH03915> shineth<WH0215><WTH8686> as the day<WH03117>: the darkness<WH02825> and the light<WH0219> <FI>are<Fi> both alike <FI>to thee<Fi> . <RF>hideth...: Heb. darkeneth not<Rf> <RF>the darkness and...: Heb. as is the darkness, so is the light<Rf>
For thou hast possessed<WH07069><WTH8804> my reins<WH03629>: thou hast covered<WH05526><WTH8799> me in my mother's<WH0517> womb<WH0990>.

I will praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thee; for I am fearfully<WH03372><WTH8737> <FI>and<Fi> wonderfully made<WH06395><WTH8738>: marvellous<WH06381><WTH8737> <FI>are<Fi> thy works<WH04639>; and <FI>that<Fi> my soul<WH05315> knoweth<WH03045><WTH8802> right well<WH03966>. <RF>right...: Heb. greatly<Rf>

My substance<WH06108> was not hid<WH03582><WTH8738> from thee, when I was made<WH06213><WTH8795> in secret<WH05643>, <FI>and<Fi> curiously wrought<WH07551><WTH8795> in the lowest parts<WH08482> of the earth<WH0776>. <RF>substance: or, strength, or, body<Rf>

Thine eyes<WH05869> did see<WH07200><WTH8804> my substance, yet being unperfect<WH01564>; and in thy book<WH05612> all <FI>my members<Fi> were written<WH03789><WTH8735>, <FI>which<Fi> in continuance<WH03117> were fashioned<WH03335><WTH8795>, when <FI>as yet there was<Fi> none<WH0259> of them. <RF>all...: Heb. all of them<Rf> <RF>which...: or, what days they should be fashioned<Rf><CM>
How precious<WH03365><WTH8804> also are thy thoughts<WH07454> unto me, O God<WH0410>! how great<WH06105><WTH8804> is the sum<WH07218> of them!
<FI> If<Fi> I should count<WH05608><WTH8799> them, they are more in number<WH07235><WTH8799> than the sand<WH02344>: when I awake<WH06974><WTH8689>, I am still<WH05750> with thee.
Surely thou wilt slay<WH06991><WTH8799> the wicked<WH07563>, O God<WH0433>: depart<WH05493><WTH8798> from me therefore, ye bloody<WH01818> men<WH0582>.
For they speak<WH0559><WTH8799> against thee wickedly<WH04209>, <FI>and<Fi> thine enemies<WH06145> take<WH05375><WTH8804> <FI>thy name<Fi> in vain<WH07723>.
Do not I hate<WH08130><WTH8799> them, O LORD<WH03068>, that hate<WH08130><WTH8764> thee? and am not I grieved<WH06962><WTH8709> with those that rise up<WH08618> against thee?
I hate<WH08130><WTH8804> them with perfect<WH08503> hatred<WH08135>: I count them mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>.
Search<WH02713><WTH8798> me, O God<WH0410>, and know<WH03045><WTH8798> my heart<WH03824>: try<WH0974><WTH8798> me, and know<WH03045><WTH8798> my thoughts<WH08312>:

And see<WH07200><WTH8798> if <FI>there be any<Fi> wicked<WH06090> way<WH01870> in me, and lead<WH05148><WTH8798> me in the way<WH01870> everlasting<WH05769>. <RF>wicked...: Heb. way of pain, or, grief<Rf><CM>
